chapter: Lee Collins and the riverboat Washington
title: Rayne and Church Point, again, and the Cotton Club band
summary: He repeats the Church Point feud story and calls the Victor Spencer band a good one.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Well they were pretty rough around that and waterproof, huh? People got drowned out.
Rain, Church Point, it's the worst places in Louisiana.

I don't know about now but that's the worst place. We played in Church Point a wedding and a feud between two families, we had to stay in a barn about two or three days. We were shooting the leg on the western front, you understand what I mean? Because you know like a man didn't want his daughter to marry in that band and all that
We had a big band with Victor Spencer, the Cotten Club band. See that was a band there when the brass was drummed, the reason was so, some bad boys, it would do you good to hear the band.
